hints.content:
For the $x$ pattern, we subtract $7$ from each row.

For the $y$ pattern, we add $1$ more to each row.

Pattern $x$: Subtract $\goldE{7}$

$\begin{align}\text{Starting term}&: \blueE{21}\\\\
\text{Term 2}&:\blueE{21} - \goldE{7}=\maroonE{14}\\\\
\text{Term 3}&:\maroonE{14} - \goldE{7}=\purpleD{7}\end{align}$

Pattern $y$: Add $\tealE{1}$

$\begin{align}\text{Starting term}&: \blueE{7}\\\\
\text{Term 2}&:\blueE{7} + \tealE{1}=\maroonE{8}\\\\
\text{Term 3}&:\maroonE{8} + \tealE{1}=\purpleD{9}\end{align}$

Our table of values should look like this:

$x$ | $y$ 
- | - | -
$21$ | $7$ 
$14$ | $8$ 
$7$ | $9$
